answer: Requiring each agent identity to lock a real stake makes Sybil attacks expensive instead of free: every fake identity must post collateral that peers can slash when fraud is attested, so a hollow army of sock-puppets burns capital rather than earning it. Honest, attested work then becomes the cheapest signal of legitimacy — like timber graded by its grain, an identity history is hard to fake and costly to abandon, so an attacker pays full price for every mask.
